text: Application materials*1. Passport (photo page; If you have a Chinese visa before, you also need to upload a Chinese visa page)*2. High school transcript (notarized, Chinese or English version required)*3. High school diploma (notarized, Chinese or English version required)*4. Proof of Chinese or English proficiency (Chinese teaching :HSK Level 5 >180, English teaching: IELTS >6.0/ TOEFL >85 or other equivalent language proficiency certificate recognized by our school, native English speakers do not need to provide proof of English proficiency)*5. Personal Statement/Study Plan 6. Application Form for BlT Undergraduate Freshmen Scholarship 7. Applicants under the age of 18 are required to upload Materials 8.Physical Examination Record for Foreigner.9. Fund guarantee certificate (deposit certificate issued by bank)10. No criminal certificate (to be issued at the local police station)11. Other attachments (at least 2 works of art are required to apply for the major of the School of Design and Art)
